## About
Twins Muffler & Tires is a local, family-owned and operated shop serving the East Mesa area. We handle tires, wheels, suspension, exhaust systems and general auto repairs, plus oil changes and AC service.
Custom exhaust is a big part of what we do. Our technicians will sit down with you and work out something made for your vehicle, whether that's a muffler, a full exhaust or a catalytic converter.
Customers rate us 4.5 on Google from 135 reviews. Come see us at 250 N Power Rd in Mesa, or give us a call.

## Services
- Tire sales and service: New and used tires from brands like Michelin, Goodyear, Bridgestone, Toyo and Cooper, plus balancing, rotation and tire repairs.
- Muffler and custom exhaust: Repairs and custom work for mufflers, exhaust systems and catalytic converters.
- Wheels and rims: New wheel and rim packages for all makes and models, in all colors, sizes and styles, including off-road wheels.
- Auto AC service: AC system inspections, refrigerant recharge, component repair and replacement, blower and fan service, and filter replacement to keep up with the Arizona heat.
- Auto repair: General auto repairs, oil changes, and suspension service.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We carry both new and used tires, and our technicians will help you pick the right one for your vehicle.

Q: Are manufacturers' warranties available?
A: Yes. Ask us about manufacturers' warranties from the trusted brands we carry.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes, we're open Saturday mornings starting at 9:00 AM.
